calls.bear_case: Continued losses and shareholder dilution; company may never reach self-sustaining revenue.

calls.video_title: Massive News for IonQ Stock Investors

Very high risk: could lose 90% or 100x.
calls.bull_case: Acquired business doubling revenue/customer base annually with no churn adds to IonQ's $246m TTM revenue; huge long-run quantum upside.
calls.bear_case: All-stock deal dilutes holders; company still loss-making, far from self-sustaining revenue, outcomes extremely uncertain (he uses a 15-25% margin of safety).
